strings.base-databank-001a.title: Imperial Presence
strings.base-databank-001a.intro.0: If you have {REP_NEG} reputation with a patrol in your space, end your action step. Otherwise, resolve the section below that matches the result rolled for the cargo.
strings.base-databank-001a.sections.0.flavor: “Attention unknown vessel. Cut thrust and prepare to be boarded or you will be fired upon.”
strings.base-databank-001a.sections.0.text.0: Fight a ship combat against TIE fighters ({SHIP_COMBAT} 3). If you win and you are not defeated, deliver this cargo and end your turn. Otherwise, end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001a.sections.1.flavor: “Nothing in these crates but foodstuffs, officer.”
strings.base-databank-001a.sections.1.text.0: Test Influence. If you pass, deliver this cargo and end your turn. If you fail, lose 1 Imperial reputation and end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001a.sections.2.text.0: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation, test Stealth. If you pass or have {REP_POS} Imperial reputation, deliver this cargo and end your turn. If you fail, lose 1 Imperial reputation and end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001b.title: Unwanted Attention
strings.base-databank-001b.intro.0: If you have {REP_NEG} reputation with a patrol in your space, end your action step. Otherwise, resolve the section below that matches the result rolled for the cargo.
strings.base-databank-001b.sections.0.flavor: “I beg your pardon. I am afraid that cargo is the property of my master, Sutha the Hutt.”
strings.base-databank-001b.sections.0.text.0: You may lose 1 Hutt reputation to deliver this cargo and end your turn. Otherwise, end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001b.sections.1.flavor: “The Rebellion needs this cargo more than you.”
strings.base-databank-001b.sections.1.text.0: You may lose 1 Rebel reputation to deliver this cargo and end your turn. Otherwise, end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001b.sections.2.flavor: “As you can see from our credentials, we are legitimate customs officials.”
strings.base-databank-001b.sections.2.text.0: You may lose 1 Syndicate reputation to deliver this cargo and end your turn. Otherwise, end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001c.title: Local Security
strings.base-databank-001c.intro.0: If you have {REP_NEG} reputation with a patrol in your space, end your action step. Otherwise, resolve the section below that matches the result rolled for the cargo.
strings.base-databank-001c.sections.0.flavor: “The boss wants what’s in the box.”
strings.base-databank-001c.sections.0.text.0: Either discard this cargo or fight a ground combat against crooks ({GROUND_COMBAT} 3). If you win and you are not defeated, deliver this cargo and end your turn. Otherwise, end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001c.sections.1.flavor: “You’ll never get past the checkpoint without being seen.”
strings.base-databank-001c.sections.1.text.0: Test Stealth. If you pass, deliver this cargo and end your turn. If you fail, lose 1 reputation with your planet’s faction and end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001c.sections.2.text.0: Test Piloting. If you pass, deliver this cargo and end your turn. If you fail, lose 1 reputation with your planet’s faction and end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001d.title: Special Interest Groups
strings.base-databank-001d.intro.0: If you have {REP_NEG} reputation with a patrol in your space, end your action step. Otherwise, resolve the section below that matches the result rolled for the cargo.
strings.base-databank-001d.sections.0.flavor: “Sure, you can move your cargo here. Just as long as my boss gets her cut.”
strings.base-databank-001d.sections.0.text.0: Deliver this cargo. Lose 1 Syndicate reputation unless you spend {CREDITS}6,000. Then end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001d.sections.1.flavor: “Now there is the matter of your docking fee. And the refueling fee. And the gratuity.”
strings.base-databank-001d.sections.1.text.0: Deliver this cargo. Lose 1 Hutt reputation unless you spend {CREDITS}6,000. Then end your turn.
strings.base-databank-001d.sections.2.flavor: “We want the cargo, but please...the Rebellion can’t afford your price.”
strings.base-databank-001d.sections.2.text.0: Deliver this cargo. Lose 1 Rebel reputation unless you spend {CREDITS}6,000. Then end your turn.
strings.base-databank-002.title: 4-LOM
strings.base-databank-002.sections.0.flavor: Logic glitches turned a protocol droid into a bounty hunter, eager for new opportunities.
strings.base-databank-002.sections.0.text.0: You may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain the crew below and discard 4-LOM’s token. Reduce this by {CREDITS}1,000 for each bounty you have.
strings.base-databank-002-asset.name: 4-LOM
strings.base-databank-003.title: Bib Fortuna
strings.base-databank-003.sections.0.flavor: “Day wanna wonga?” he asks as he steps from the shadows. This is your chance to gain the ear of Jabba the Hutt.
strings.base-databank-003.sections.0.text.0: You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to choose a player. Make that player gain or lose 1 Hutt reputation.
strings.base-databank-003.sections.0.text.1: After resolving this card, move Bib Fortuna’s token to an empty contact space on Tatooine. If there is not an empty contact space, exchange this token with a contact on Tatooine.
strings.base-databank-004.title: Black Krrsantan
strings.base-databank-004.sections.0.flavor: The infamous Wookiee bounty hunter could be a valuable ally...or a dangerous enemy.
strings.base-databank-004.sections.0.text.0: If you have a bounty or job, you may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the crew below and discard Black Krrsantan’s token.
strings.base-databank-004.sections.0.text.1: If you do not gain the crew, and you have at least 1 {REP_NEG} reputation, fight a ground combat ({GROUND_COMBAT} 4). If you win, discard Black Krrsantan’s token.
strings.base-databank-004-asset.name: Black Krrsantan
strings.base-databank-004-asset.text.0: At the start of ground combat, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain +2 {GROUND_COMBAT} for that combat.
strings.base-databank-005.title: Black Sun Agent
strings.base-databank-005.sections.0.flavor: Black Sun has agents everywhere. Their network of connections is the syndicate’s greatest strength.
strings.base-databank-005.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_NEG} Syndicate reputation, test Stealth. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-005.sections.0.text.1: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation, you may test Influence. If you pass, gain the crew below and discard Black Sun Agent’s token. If you would fail, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to pass this test instead.
strings.base-databank-005-asset.name: Black Sun Agent
strings.base-databank-005-asset.text.0: Increase the reward for each of your jobs by {CREDITS}2,000.
strings.base-databank-006.title: BoShek
strings.base-databank-006.sections.0.flavor: “Don’t say ‘smuggler,’” says the Corellian. “I prefer ‘freelance pilot for hire.’ Speaking of, are you hiring?”
strings.base-databank-006.sections.0.text.0: You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain the crew below and discard BoShek’s token.
strings.base-databank-006-asset.name: BoShek
strings.base-databank-006-asset.text.0: If you do not roll a {HIT} when delivering ILLEGAL cargo, you may reroll your die.
strings.base-databank-007.title: Chewbacca
strings.base-databank-007.sections.0.flavor: In his long life, Chewbacca has learned many useful skills. You couldn’t ask for a better ally.
strings.base-databank-007.sections.0.text.0: If you are Han Solo, you may gain the crew below and discard Chewbacca’s token.
strings.base-databank-007.sections.0.text.1: Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}4,000 to gain the crew below and discard Chewbacca’s token.
strings.base-databank-007-asset.name: Chewbacca
strings.base-databank-008.title: Dengar
strings.base-databank-008.sections.0.flavor: Dengar has a fearsome reputation and decades of experience. You can only hope that you’re not the bounty he’s after.
strings.base-databank-008.sections.0.text.0: If you have at least 1 {REP_NEG} reputation, fight a ground combat against Dengar ({GROUND_COMBAT} 5). If you win, gain 1 fame and discard Dengar’s token.
strings.base-databank-008.sections.0.text.1: If you lose or have no {REP_NEG} reputation, place Dengar’s token facedown on his contact space or an empty contact space.
strings.base-databank-009.title: Doctor Evazan
strings.base-databank-009.sections.0.text.0: Test Strength. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage. Pass or fail, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain the crew below and discard Doctor Evazan’s token.
strings.base-databank-009-asset.name: Doctor Evazan
strings.base-databank-009-asset.text.0: At the start of ground combat, choose a die result. During the combat, both players may turn up to 2 of their blank dice to the chosen result.
strings.base-databank-010.title: Garindan
strings.base-databank-010.sections.0.flavor: This Kubaz spy regularly sells information to the Empire, but he’ll work for you if the price is right.
strings.base-databank-010.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation or {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, test Stealth. If you fail, move the Imperial patrol directly to your space and encounter it.
strings.base-databank-010.sections.0.text.1: If you pass or did not perform the test, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain the crew below and discard Garindan’s token.
strings.base-databank-010-asset.name: Garindan
strings.base-databank-010-asset.text.0: Action: Spend {CREDITS}1,000 to secretly look at a contact token on any planet.
strings.base-databank-011.title: Grand Admiral Thrawn
strings.base-databank-011.sections.0.flavor: The Grand Admiral is looking for someone to sabotage a Rebel cell. You get the feeling that you’re only one part of a larger plan.
strings.base-databank-011.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation, you may discard Grand Admiral Thrawn’s token and gain the job below.
strings.base-databank-011.sections.0.text.1: If you have {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation, fight a ground combat against Deathtroopers ({GROUND_COMBAT} 4). If you win, prevent 2 damage from this combat.
strings.base-databank-011-asset.name: Rebellion on Lothal
strings.base-databank-011-asset.reward: Lose 1 Rebel reputation and gain {CREDITS}7,000, 1 fame, and 1 Imperial reputation. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-databank-012.title: Greedo
strings.base-databank-012.sections.0.flavor: Greedo has been hired by Jabba the Hutt to hunt down those who have wronged him.
strings.base-databank-012.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_NEG} Hutt reputation, test Stealth. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-012.sections.0.text.1: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Hutt reputation, you may test Influence. If you pass, gain the crew below and discard Greedo’s token. If you would fail, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to pass this test instead.
strings.base-databank-012-asset.name: Greedo
strings.base-databank-012-asset.text.0: After you roll dice during ground combat, you may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to add 1 {HIT}.
strings.base-databank-013.title: Hera Syndulla
strings.base-databank-013.sections.0.flavor: “There’s enough darkness in the galaxy right now. Let me know if you want to spread a little light.”
strings.base-databank-013.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation or {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain the crew below and discard Hera Syndulla’s token.
strings.base-databank-013.sections.0.text.1: If you do not gain the crew, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain 1 Rebel reputation.
strings.base-databank-013-asset.name: Hera Syndulla
strings.base-databank-013-asset.text.0: Action: If you are not at the Maelstrom, test Tech. If you pass, move 1 space. If you fail, your ship suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-014.title: Hondo Ohnaka
strings.base-databank-014.sections.0.flavor: “Haha, my friend! With my brains and your...ahem...capital...why, we will both be rich!”
strings.base-databank-014.sections.0.text.0: You may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain the crew below and discard Hondo Ohnaka’s token.
strings.base-databank-014-asset.name: Hondo Ohnaka
strings.base-databank-014-asset.text.0: Increase the reward on each of your cargo by {CREDITS}2,000.
strings.base-databank-015.title: IG-RM Droid
strings.base-databank-015.sections.0.flavor: This bodyguard and enforcer droid works for Cikatro Vizago...but with a little reprogramming, it could work for you.
strings.base-databank-015.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_NEG} Syndicate reputation, test Stealth. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-015.sections.0.text.1: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation, you may test Tech. If you pass, gain the crew below and discard IG-RM Droid’s token.
strings.base-databank-015-asset.name: IG-RM Droid
strings.base-databank-016.title: K-2SO
strings.base-databank-016.sections.0.flavor: He thinks you might be a Rebel spy, so you’ll need a creative way of convincing him otherwise.
strings.base-databank-016.sections.0.text.0: You may test Tech. If you pass, gain the crew below and discard K-2SO’s token. If you fail and you have either {REP_POS} Rebel reputation or {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation, your character suffers 3 damage.
strings.base-databank-016-asset.name: K-2SO
strings.base-databank-016-asset.text.0: During ground combat, each of your opponent’s {CRIT} results count as 1 damage instead of 2.
strings.base-databank-017.title: Leia Organa
strings.base-databank-017.sections.0.flavor: “In a time of fear, we have only one weapon left: hope. Fortunately, that is all that we require.”
strings.base-databank-017.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation, you may discard Leia Organa’s token and gain the job below.
strings.base-databank-017.sections.0.text.1: If you do not gain the job, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain 1 Rebel reputation.
strings.base-databank-017-asset.name: Rebel Prison Break
strings.base-databank-017-asset.encounter: Resolve card #47. If you have {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation you may resolve this card instead of encountering the Imperial patrol.
strings.base-databank-017-asset.reward: Lose 1 Imperial reputation and gain 2 fame and 1 Rebel reputation. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-databank-018.title: Lobot
strings.base-databank-018.sections.0.flavor: Lobot’s brain-enhancing device allows him direct contact with complex computer systems. Surely you can find a use for such skills.
strings.base-databank-018.sections.0.text.0: If you are Lando Calrissian, you may gain the crew below and discard Lobot’s token.
strings.base-databank-018.sections.0.text.1: Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain the crew below and discard Lobot’s token.
strings.base-databank-018-asset.name: Lobot
strings.base-databank-018-asset.text.0: When you choose to gain credits during the planning phase, gain an additional {CREDITS}1,000 for each {REP_POS} reputation you have.
strings.base-databank-019.title: Maz Kanata
strings.base-databank-019.sections.0.flavor: They call her the smuggler queen of Takodana. It seems there’s nothing Maz does not know.
strings.base-databank-019.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation, you may spend {CREDITS}4,000 to gain the crew below and discard Maz Kanata’s token.
strings.base-databank-019.sections.0.text.1: If you do not gain this crew, move Maz Kanata’s token to an empty contact space on Takodana. If there is not an empty contact space, exchange this token with a contact on Takodana.
strings.base-databank-019-asset.name: Maz Kanata
strings.base-databank-019-asset.text.0: Once per turn, after you roll dice for a skill test, you may reroll 1 of your dice.
strings.base-databank-020.title: Ponda Baba
strings.base-databank-020.sections.0.flavor: He doesn’t like you, but a few credits may change his mind.
strings.base-databank-020.sections.0.text.0: Test Strength. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage. Pass or fail, you may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain the crew below and discard Ponda Baba’s token.
strings.base-databank-020-asset.name: Ponda Baba
strings.base-databank-020-asset.text.0: During ground combat, if you have at least 2 {FOCUS} results, you win the combat regardless of your opponent’s results.
strings.base-databank-021.title: Saw Gerrera
strings.base-databank-021.sections.0.flavor: Even the Rebel Alliance finds Saw Gerrera too extreme.
strings.base-databank-021.sections.0.text.0: If you are Jyn Erso, you may gain the crew below and discard Saw Gerrera’s token.
strings.base-databank-021.sections.0.text.1: If you are not Jyn Erso and you have {REP_NEG} Rebel reputation or {REP_POS} Imperial reputation, test Stealth. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-021.sections.0.text.2: If you did not test Stealth, you may test Influence. If you pass, gain the crew below and discard Saw Gerrera’s token.
strings.base-databank-021-asset.name: Saw Gerrera
strings.base-databank-021-asset.text.0: Action: Choose another character or ship in your space; it suffers 2 damage. If that player has {REP_POS} Imperial reputation, it suffers 1 additional damage.
strings.base-databank-022.title: W1-LE
strings.base-databank-022.sections.0.flavor: Most droids are rather high-strung, so W1-LE’s laid-back demeanor and easy charm are a pleasant surprise.
strings.base-databank-022.sections.0.text.0: If you are Lando Calrissian, you may gain the crew below and discard W1-LE’s token.
strings.base-databank-022.sections.0.text.1: Otherwise, you may test Tech. If you pass, gain the crew below and discard W1-LE’s token. If you would fail, you may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to pass this test instead.
strings.base-databank-022-asset.name: W1-LE
strings.base-databank-022-asset.text.0: Encounter: Perform a market action, even if you are at a navpoint or performed this action during your action step.
strings.base-databank-023.title: Ziton Moj
strings.base-databank-023.sections.0.flavor: “This opportunity benefits us both. But there will be a cost.”
strings.base-databank-023.sections.0.text.0: You may lose 1 Syndicate reputation to either gain {CREDITS}5,000 or take up to {CREDITS}5,000 from a player that has more fame than you.
strings.base-databank-040a.title: An Epic Game of Sabacc
strings.base-databank-040a.sections.0.flavor: This is it: the hand you’ve waited your whole life for. It’s time to up the stakes.
strings.base-databank-040a.sections.0.text.0: You may place any amount of your credits on this card. If you do not, skip to step 3.
strings.base-databank-040a.sections.1.text.0: Your opponent may place the same amount of their credits on this card (or all of their credits if they do not have enough). If they do not, you gain the reward and any credits on this card.
strings.base-databank-040a.sections.2.flavor: All that remains is to play out the hand.
strings.base-databank-040a.sections.2.text.0: You choose to test either Knowledge or Tactics. Then, your opponent chooses to test either Knowledge or Tactics.
strings.base-databank-040a.sections.2.text.1: If only 1 player passes, that player gains the reward and all credits on this card.
strings.base-databank-040a.sections.2.text.2: If both players pass or both players fail, repeat this step.
strings.base-databank-040b.title: A Friendly Game of Sabacc
strings.base-databank-040b.sections.0.flavor: You are dealt a bad hand. Hilariously bad. Perhaps you can bluff your way to victory.
strings.base-databank-040b.sections.0.text.0: You test Influence. If you pass, skip to step 3.
strings.base-databank-040b.sections.1.flavor: With your weakness exposed, your opponent has an opportunity to finish the game quickly.
strings.base-databank-040b.sections.1.text.0: The other player tests Tactics. If they pass, they gain the reward.
strings.base-databank-040b.sections.2.flavor: You’re back in the game and putting it all on the table. The winner will be decided by this hand.
strings.base-databank-040b.sections.2.text.0: You test Tactics. If you pass, you gain the reward. If you fail, the other player gains the reward.
strings.base-databank-040c.title: A Cutthroat Game of Sabacc
strings.base-databank-040c.sections.0.flavor: You’ve barely started playing and you’re already about to lose. Maybe it’s time to cheat.
strings.base-databank-040c.sections.0.text.0: You can choose to cheat. If you do, skip to step 3.
strings.base-databank-040c.sections.1.flavor: Your opponent calls, and you’re left with two options. Either take your losses or open fire.
strings.base-databank-040c.sections.1.text.0: You choose to either fight a ground combat against your opponent or let your opponent gain the reward.
strings.base-databank-040c.sections.1.text.1: If you fight a combat, the winner gains the reward.
strings.base-databank-040c.sections.2.flavor: You pull a card from your sleeve and hope that your opponent doesn’t notice.
strings.base-databank-040c.sections.2.text.0: You test Stealth. If you pass, you gain the reward. If you fail, the other player chooses to either proceed to step 2 or test Influence.
strings.base-databank-040c.sections.2.text.1: If they test Influence and pass, they gain the reward. If they fail, you gain the reward.
strings.base-databank-041a.title: Tenuous Alliance
strings.base-databank-041a.intro.0: Resolve the section below that matches the job you are resolving.
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.0.heading: HUTT FAVOR
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.0.flavor: The Hutt wonders if you work for his rivals.
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.0.text.0: If you have {REP_POS} Syndicate reputation, discard this job.
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.1.heading: IMPERIAL FAVOR
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.1.flavor: You are accused of being a Rebel sympathizer.
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.1.text.0: If you have {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, discard this job.
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.2.heading: REBEL FAVOR
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.2.text.0: If you have {REP_POS} Imperial reputation, discard this job.
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.3.heading: SYNDICATE FAVOR
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.3.flavor: The boss fears that you may be allied with her enemies.
strings.base-databank-041a.sections.3.text.0: If you have {REP_POS} Hutt reputation, discard this job.
strings.base-databank-041b.title: Lost Faith
strings.base-databank-041b.intro.0: Resolve the section below that matches the job you are resolving.
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.0.heading: HUTT FAVOR
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.0.flavor: The Hutts are not forgiving of failure.
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.0.text.0: Test Influence. If you fail, lose 1 Hutt reputation.
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.1.heading: IMPERIAL FAVOR
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.1.flavor: The Empire does not accept failure.
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.1.text.0: Test Influence. If you fail, lose 1 Imperial reputation.
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.2.heading: REBEL FAVOR
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.2.flavor: Your recklessness has almost exposed the Rebellion. You claim that it was not your fault.
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.2.text.0: Test Influence. If you fail, lose 1 Rebel reputation.
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.3.heading: SYNDICATE FAVOR
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.3.flavor: Your failure is a sign of weakness.
strings.base-databank-041b.sections.3.text.0: Test Influence. If you fail, lose 1 Syndicate reputation.
strings.base-databank-042.title: The Casino Heist
strings.base-databank-042.sections.0.flavor: The first part of the plan involves distracting the security guard with small talk.
strings.base-databank-042.sections.0.text.0: Test Influence. If you fail, the job fails (keep the job card).
strings.base-databank-042.sections.1.flavor: You try to slice into their system and add some credits to your account.
strings.base-databank-042.sections.1.text.0: Test Tech. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage and skip to step 4.
strings.base-databank-042.sections.2.flavor: Just as you’re finishing up, a patrolling officer notices you. You’ll need to quickly subdue him.
strings.base-databank-042.sections.2.text.0: Test Strength. If you pass, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-042.sections.3.flavor: An alarm is raised and security storms the room!
strings.base-databank-042.sections.3.text.0: Fight a ground combat against the local security ({GROUND_COMBAT} 3). If you win and you are not defeated, complete this job. If you lose, repeat this step.
strings.base-databank-043.title: Jabba’s Hidden Stash
strings.base-databank-043.sections.0.flavor: The first step of the plan involves taking an airspeeder through treacherous bluffs to a hidden cave.
strings.base-databank-043.sections.0.text.0: Test Piloting. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-043.sections.1.flavor: You slip into the cave and see many guards blocking the entrance. There are too many of them, so you’ll need to sneak by.
strings.base-databank-043.sections.1.text.0: Test Stealth. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-043.sections.2.flavor: You find a back passageway, but the way through is treacherous. Is there another way in?
strings.base-databank-043.sections.2.text.0: Test Knowledge. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-043.sections.3.flavor: The vault is booby-trapped. You try to disable it.
strings.base-databank-043.sections.3.text.0: Test Tech. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage. If you are not defeated, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-044.title: Hijacking a Freighter
strings.base-databank-044.sections.0.flavor: You try to dock with the freighter without attracting attention.
strings.base-databank-044.sections.0.text.0: Test Piloting. If you fail, your ship suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-044.sections.1.flavor: Once on the ship, you need to pull open a sealed compartment so you can slice the computer.
strings.base-databank-044.sections.1.text.0: Test Strength and then test Tech.
strings.base-databank-044.sections.1.text.1: If you pass both of them, skip to step 4. If you fail at least 1 of them, your ship suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-044.sections.2.flavor: The slicing fails, and you instead try to blow up the docking clamps.
strings.base-databank-044.sections.2.text.0: Test Tactics. If you fail, your ship suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-044.sections.3.flavor: A swarm of Black Sun fighters are in hot pursuit. You try to draw them off.
strings.base-databank-044.sections.3.text.0: Fight a ship combat against Black Sun fighters ({SHIP_COMBAT} 3). If you win, prevent 1 damage from this combat. If you are not defeated, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-045.title: The Jewel of Yavin
strings.base-databank-045.sections.0.flavor: You’ll need to find a safe path through the most dangerous part of the city.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.0.text.0: Test Knowledge. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.1.flavor: You run afoul of some local criminals.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.1.text.0: Test Tactics. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage unless you lose {CREDITS}3,000.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.2.flavor: You must talk your way past security.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.2.text.0: Test Influence. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.3.flavor: Now to avoid the automated defense system.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.3.text.0: Test Stealth. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.4.flavor: The jewel sits before you. Just don’t trip the alarm.
strings.base-databank-045.sections.4.text.0: Test Tech. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, fight a ground combat against local security ({GROUND_COMBAT} 4). If you win, prevent 2 damage from this combat. Win or lose, if you are not defeated, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-046.title: The Kessel Run
strings.base-databank-046.sections.0.flavor: You claim to be a crime lord looking to invest money in the spice trade.
strings.base-databank-046.sections.0.text.0: Test Influence. If you fail, the job fails (keep the job card).
strings.base-databank-046.sections.1.flavor: You find the hyperfuel, but you can hardly lift it.
strings.base-databank-046.sections.1.text.0: Test Strength. If you fail, the job fails (keep the job card).
strings.base-databank-046.sections.2.flavor: The auto-turrets open fire. Take them out!
strings.base-databank-046.sections.2.text.0: Test Tactics. If you fail, your ship suffers 2 damage
strings.base-databank-046.sections.3.flavor: You stow the dangerous cargo as safely as you can.
strings.base-databank-046.sections.3.text.0: Test Knowledge. If you fail, your ship suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-046.sections.4.flavor: A Star Destroyer appears, and you plunge into the Maelstrom.
strings.base-databank-046.sections.4.text.0: Move to the Maelstrom then test Piloting. If you fail, your ship suffers 1 damage and repeat this step. If you pass, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-047.title: Rebel Prison Break
strings.base-databank-047.sections.0.flavor: You identify the Imperial ship and attempt to approach undetected.
strings.base-databank-047.sections.0.text.0: Test Stealth. If you pass, skip to step 4.
strings.base-databank-047.sections.1.flavor: You’ve been spotted and a squadron of TIE fighters moves to intercept you.
strings.base-databank-047.sections.1.text.0: Fight a ship combat against TIE fighters ({SHIP_COMBAT} 3). If you win, skip to step 4.
strings.base-databank-047.sections.2.flavor: One of the TIEs is still tailing you, so you fly dangerously close to the larger ship.
strings.base-databank-047.sections.2.text.0: Test Piloting. If you fail, your ship suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-047.sections.3.flavor: You dock with the Imperial ship and find your way to the cell block. That’s when the Stormtroopers arrive.
strings.base-databank-047.sections.3.text.0: Fight a ground combat against Stormtroopers ({GROUND_COMBAT} 3). If you win and you are not defeated, complete this job. If you lose, repeat this step.
strings.base-databank-048.title: Rebellion on Lothal
strings.base-databank-048.sections.0.flavor: You feign interest in the Rebel cause hoping to gain access to their facilities.
strings.base-databank-048.sections.0.text.0: Test Influence. If you pass, skip to step 3. If you fail you may lose 1 Rebel reputation to skip to step 3.
strings.base-databank-048.sections.1.flavor: They see through your deception and attempt to subdue you.
strings.base-databank-048.sections.1.text.0: Fight a ground combat against Rebel guards ({GROUND_COMBAT} 4). If you win, skip to step 4.
strings.base-databank-048.sections.2.flavor: You attempt to steal several heavy crates of unstable explosives.
strings.base-databank-048.sections.2.text.0: Test Strength. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-databank-048.sections.3.flavor: You set some charges in the Rebel facility and attempt to escape before it explodes.
strings.base-databank-048.sections.3.text.0: Test Tactics. If you fail, your character suffers 3 damage. If you are not defeated, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-049.title: Relic of the Past
strings.base-databank-049.sections.0.flavor: You need to decipher your map to find the entrance to the temple.
strings.base-databank-049.sections.0.text.0: Test Knowledge. If you fail, the job fails (keep the job).
strings.base-databank-049.sections.1.flavor: You enter the temple but your first step triggers a trap. Proceed with caution!
strings.base-databank-049.sections.1.text.0: Test Stealth. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-049.sections.2.flavor: You pluck the priceless relic off the pedestal, but the room starts to fill with water. A large boulder crashes down from the ceiling, blocking your only escape route.
strings.base-databank-049.sections.2.text.0: Test Tactics. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage and repeat this step. If you pass, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-050.title: Rescue from the Mines
strings.base-databank-050.sections.0.flavor: There’s a back door to the mines...somewhere.
strings.base-databank-050.sections.0.text.0: Test Knowledge. If you fail, skip to step 3.
strings.base-databank-050.sections.1.flavor: You enter through a grate in the floor and make your way to the slave quarters.
strings.base-databank-050.sections.1.text.0: Test Stealth. If you pass, skip to step 5.
strings.base-databank-050.sections.2.text.0: Fight a ground combat against Pyke sentinels ({GROUND_COMBAT} 4). If you win, skip to step 5.
strings.base-databank-050.sections.3.flavor: The last sentinel brandishes a stun spear.
strings.base-databank-050.sections.3.text.0: Test Strength. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage and repeat this step.
strings.base-databank-050.sections.4.flavor: The door to the prisoner’s cell is locked, but so corroded with rust that one good kick should open it.
strings.base-databank-050.sections.4.text.0: Test Strength. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage and repeat this step.
strings.base-databank-051.title: Rooting Out Spies
strings.base-databank-051.sections.0.flavor: You ask an information broker about the presence of Imperial spies.
strings.base-databank-051.sections.0.text.0: Test Influence. If you pass, skip to step 3.
strings.base-databank-051.sections.1.flavor: The broker betrays you, and her minions try to punish you for poking around.
strings.base-databank-051.sections.1.text.0: Fight a ground combat against minions ({GROUND_COMBAT} 3). If you win, prevent 1 damage from this combat.
strings.base-databank-051.sections.2.flavor: The spies are getting away, but you think you know a shortcut through the basement.
strings.base-databank-051.sections.2.text.0: Test Knowledge. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage and repeat this step.
strings.base-databank-051.sections.3.flavor: You locate the spies, but they are about to leave on their ship. You open fire from a distance, hoping to hit your target.
strings.base-databank-051.sections.3.text.0: Test Tactics. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage and repeat this step. If you pass, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-052.title: Steal a Fathier
strings.base-databank-052.sections.0.flavor: You intend to steal the fathier favored to win tomorrow’s race. You’ll need to find a hole in the stable’s security first.
strings.base-databank-052.sections.0.text.0: Test Knowledge. If you fail, the job fails (keep the job card).
strings.base-databank-052.sections.1.flavor: You discover there is a late-night shift change for the stable guards that should give you an opening.
strings.base-databank-052.sections.1.text.0: Test Stealth. If you pass, skip to step 4.
strings.base-databank-052.sections.2.flavor: The guards spot you and open fire!
strings.base-databank-052.sections.2.text.0: Fight a ground combat against guards ({GROUND_COMBAT} 3). If you win, prevent 1 damage from this combat.
strings.base-databank-052.sections.3.flavor: Now to tranquilize the beast and haul it back to your ship.
strings.base-databank-052.sections.3.text.0: Test Strength. If you fail, return to step 3. If you pass, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-053.title: Wookiee Slave Trade
strings.base-databank-053.sections.0.flavor: The slaver’s ship has landed on the planet surface, and a few Trandoshan guards stand watch.
strings.base-databank-053.sections.0.text.0: Test Stealth. If you pass, skip to step 3.
strings.base-databank-053.sections.1.flavor: The guards see you coming and draw their weapons.
strings.base-databank-053.sections.1.text.0: Fight a ground combat against Trandoshan guards ({GROUND_COMBAT} 3). If you win, prevent 1 damage from this combat.
strings.base-databank-053.sections.2.flavor: You board the ship and see the slaves locked in a peculiar cell. Hopefully there are no booby traps.
strings.base-databank-053.sections.2.text.0: Test Knowledge. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-053.sections.3.flavor: You try to take control of the ship so the Wookiees can fly their way back home.
strings.base-databank-053.sections.3.text.0: Test Tech. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage and repeat this step. If you pass, complete this job.
strings.base-databank-090a.title: Lobot
strings.base-databank-090a-asset.name: Lobot
strings.base-databank-090a-asset.capture_reward: Deliver Lobot’s token to Cantonica to gain {CREDITS}10,000 and 1 fame.
strings.base-databank-090a-asset.text.0: After you gain a reward from this card, remove it from the game.
strings.base-databank-090b.title: Ponda Baba
strings.base-databank-090b-asset.name: Ponda Baba
strings.base-databank-090b-asset.capture_reward: Deliver Ponda Baba’s token to Takodana to gain {CREDITS}10,000 and 1 fame.

strings.base-databank-092a-asset.name: Pirate Trouble
strings.base-databank-092a-asset.flavor: A band of pirates have stolen a precious heirloom from a local crime lord. You’ve been hired to retrieve it.
strings.base-databank-092a-asset.encounter: Test Piloting. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, your ship suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-092a-asset.reward: Gain {CREDITS}4,000 and 1 fame. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-databank-092b.title: Heavy Hitters
strings.base-databank-092b-asset.name: Heavy Hitters
strings.base-databank-092b-asset.flavor: An up-and-coming crime boss is looking for a security escort to his meeting with some unsavory folk.
strings.base-databank-092b-asset.encounter: Test Strength. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-092b-asset.reward: Gain {CREDITS}4,000 and 1 fame. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-databank-092c.title: Safe Passage
strings.base-databank-092c-asset.name: Safe Passage
strings.base-databank-092c-asset.flavor: A Pyke capo is looking for someone to escort him through a dangerous sector of space.
strings.base-databank-092c-asset.encounter: Test Strength or Piloting. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, your character and ship both suffer 1 damage.
strings.base-databank-092c-asset.reward: Gain {CREDITS}5,000 and 1 fame. Then remove this card from the game.
In Canto Bight casino, you find a large crowd gathered around a dice game.
You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to roll 2 dice. If you roll at least 1 {HIT}, either gain {CREDITS}4,000 or roll 2 dice. If you roll at least 1 {HIT} again, gain {CREDITS}8,000.
“You lookin’ for da big boom?” the shopkeeper asks as he opens a sealed case full of explosives.
You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the gear below.
strings.base-encounter-cantonica-ord-mantell-05-: After you roll dice during ground combat, you may discard this card to add 2 {HIT}.
You find yourself offered a game of chance in a rundown sector of the city. A Falleen hands you a set of chance cubes. “You paying credits or collateral?” he asks.
You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 or discard 1 of your cargo to roll 1 die. On a {HIT}, gain {CREDITS}5,000.
“I don’t know many people who are fireproof,” the arms dealer says as he shows you a flame thrower. “You’re not hunting droids, are you?”
You may spend {CREDITS}5,000 to gain the gear below.
strings.base-encounter-cantonica-ord-mantell-06-: During ground combat against a non-droid({DROID}), you may turn 1 of your {FOCUS} or {HIT} results to {CRIT}.
You run across a few inebriated casino patrons in a dark alley.
You may test Strength. If you pass, gain {CREDITS}3,000. If you fail, your character suffers 1 damage.
The Nikto seems anxious to offload this equipment.
Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_GEAR} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed gear with a discount of {CREDITS}1,000. Then shuffle the deck.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
Black Sun is on the lookout for someone who has wronged them.
Action: If there is another player in your space that has {REP_NEG} Syndicate reputation, discard this card to gain 1 Syndicate reputation and move the Syndicate patrol up to 3 spaces toward you.
A Duros pickpocket robs you, but not without you noticing. You’re impressed and try to convince him to join your crew.
Lose {CREDITS}1,000 and test Influence. If you pass, you may gain the crew below.
A local information broker will pay for good intel.
You may lose 1 reputation from a faction you have {REP_POS} reputation with to gain {CREDITS}4,000.
strings.base-encounter-cantonica-ord-mantell-08-: Action: Discard this card to take {CREDITS}5,000 from a player in your space.
You make a deal with the local establishment to run a high-stakes sabacc tournament. Opponents from across the galaxy come to participate.

Choose another player that has at least {CREDITS}4,000. That player chooses whether or not to participate. If they do, they move directly to Cantonica. Then, you each lose {CREDITS}4,000, and you resolve card #40.
Reward: Gain {CREDITS}8,000.
If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
A friend of a friend refers you to a local loan shark.
You may lose 1 Syndicate reputation to gain {CREDITS}5,000.
The Trandoshan claims that you owe his boss credits.
Fight a ground combat against a Trandoshan ({GROUND_COMBAT} 4) unless you spend {CREDITS}5,000.
A down-on-her-luck pilot is looking for a new gig.
You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the crew below.
The guards refuse to let anyone into the fortress except loyal members of Black Sun.
If you have {REP_POS} Syndicate reputation, gain {CREDITS}5,000. If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation, you may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain 1 Syndicate reputation.
strings.base-encounter-cantonica-ord-mantell-00-: When you would fail a skill test, you may discard this card to pass that test instead.
You find runaway stable hands stowed away on your ship. They tell you they are trying to make money to buy their freedom. You consider turning them in to the authorities.
Gain either {CREDITS}2,000 or the crew below.
You discover a Rebel transport, the Freedom Fighter, resupplying on this planet.
You may lose 1 Rebel reputation to gain {CREDITS}2,000 and 1 Imperial reputation.
strings.base-encounter-cantonica-ord-mantell-01-: Action: If at a Rebel or Imperial planet, spend {CREDITS}6,000 and discard this card to gain 1 fame.
A bookie asks for your help taking bets on the next big race at the Canto Bight racetrack.

Choose a die result. Each other player may give you {CREDITS}1,000 to also choose a die result. Then, you roll 1 die. Each player that chose the result rolled gains credits based on their chosen result:
{CRIT}: {CREDITS}8,000
{FOCUS}: {CREDITS}5,000
{HIT}: {CREDITS}3,000
A crime lord is running out of patience with one of her bounty hunters, so she is sending another hunter after the bounty.
Action: Discard this card to take a bounty that matches a contact in your space from a player in any space.
The house always wins, unless you cheat.
You may spend up to {CREDITS}3,000 to test Tactics. If you pass, gain twice the amount you spent. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
Black Sun is willing to give you funds to help you pursue your bounties.
Gain {CREDITS}3,000 for each bounty you have. If you have no bounties, you may buy the top bounty card from the {DECK_BOUNTY} market deck.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
Black Sun is looking for someone brave (or foolish) enough to fight a Mantellian Savrip barehanded.
You may test Strength. If you pass, gain {CREDITS}3,000 and 1 Syndicate reputation. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
You sit down to a dice game in the Canto Bight casino.
You may spend {CREDITS}1,000. If you do, name any number and then roll 5 dice. If you roll at least as many {HIT} as the named number, gain credits equal the named number × 2,000.
“You look like someone in a dangerous line of work,” the street vendor says. “You’d do well to have one of these on hand.”
You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the gear below.
strings.base-encounter-cantonica-ord-mantell-04-: When you would become defeated during a ground combat, if you are not a droid ({DROID}), you may discard this card to recover all damage on your character instead.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-06.secti: The mines always have plenty of spice. Now you just need to find a buyer.
You may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain the cargo below. If you have {REP_POS} Syndicate reputation, you may gain the cargo by spending {CREDITS}1,000 instead.
You encounter a large scattering of debris.
Test Piloting. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and your ship suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-06-asset: To deliver, roll a die. On a {HIT}, deliver this. Otherwise, resolve card #1.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-08.secti: While visiting a remote station, you see an opportunity to free some slaves from the mines.
You may test Stealth. If you pass, gain 1 fame and lose 2 Syndicate reputation. If you fail, your character suffers 4 damage.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain 1 Syndicate reputation.
An electrical storm knocks out your power systems.
Your ship suffers 1 damage. Test Tech. If you pass, recover up to 2 damage from your ship and take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-09.secti: Unrefined coaxium is very unstable and is known to spontaneously explode. Is the payout worth it?
You may lose 1 Syndicate reputation or spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain the cargo below.
You nearly fly into a giant space-faring beast.
Test Piloting or Knowledge. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and your ship suffers 3 damage.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-09-asset: At the end of your action step, roll a die. On a {CRIT}, discard this card and your ship suffers 4 damage.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-00.secti: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
It seems that someone is selling stolen goods here.
Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_CARGO} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed ILLEGAL cargo with a discount of {CREDITS}1,000. Then shuffle the deck.
You have the opportunity to influence a Pyke capo.
You may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain 1 Syndicate reputation.
A chunk of debris is flying straight toward you.
Test Piloting. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and discard 1 of your mods. If you did not have a mod, your ship suffers 3 damage.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-01.secti: It seems that everyone has a hand in the local slave trade. Will you stand by or will you act?

You may lose 2 Hutt, 2 Imperial, or 2 Syndicate reputation to gain 1 fame. (You can only do this if you had {REP_POS} reputation with that faction.)
If you do not gain fame, you may discard 1 of your crew to gain {CREDITS}3,000 and 1 Syndicate reputation.
An Imperial TIE fighter has followed you into the Maelstrom. You’ll need to destroy it before you can escape.

If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation, fight a ship combat against a TIE fighter ({SHIP_COMBAT} 3). If you lose, move 1 space. If you win or did not resolve a combat, move 1 space and then take an additional turn.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-02.secti: The Pyke syndicate wants you to send a message to the Hutts.
You may take the “Syndicate Favor” job card from another player or the {DECK_JOB} market deck. If you take it from the {DECK_JOB} deck, shuffle that deck.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
A Pyke capo fears that the workers may be planning a revolt and asks for you to spy on them.
You may test Stealth. If you pass, gain 1 Syndicate reputation. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.
The nebula’s gases render your sensors ineffective.
Test Piloting or Tech. If you pass, take an additional turn.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-03.secti: The Pykes are looking for a trustworthy smuggler.
Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_CARGO} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed ILLEGAL cargo for free. Then shuffle the deck.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
No one hauls illegal cargo through this sector without Pyke approval.
If you do not have any cargo, you may move 1 space. Otherwise, lose {CREDITS}3,000 and gain 1 Syndicate reputation.
A massive tentacle grasps at your ship.
Fight a ship combat against a creature ({SHIP_COMBAT} 4). If you win, prevent all damage from this combat and take an additional turn. If you lose, move 1 space.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-04.secti: Criminals may respect a wanted outlaw, but they’ll still turn you in for a reward.

You may lose 1 reputation from a faction you have {REP_NEU} reputation with.
Gain {CREDITS}3,000 for each faction you have {REP_NEG} reputation with. Then, for each faction you have {REP_NEG} reputation with, move that faction’s patrol 4 spaces toward you.
The Maelstrom makes for a good spot for an ambush.

You may move 1 patrol directly to your space and encounter it. During the combat, you add 1 {CRIT}. After the combat, move 1 space.
If you do not fight a combat, test Piloting. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and your ship suffers 3 damage.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-05.secti: In crime, as in any business, it’s more about who you know than what you know.

You may lose 1 reputation from a faction you have {REP_POS} reputation with to gain {CREDITS}4,000. If you do, you may lose 1 reputation from another faction you have {REP_POS} reputation with to gain 1 fame.
A gravity well is pulling you backward. If you could lose some weight, you might escape unscathed.
You may discard 1 of your cargo or mods to take an additional turn. If you do not discard a card, move 1 space and your ship suffers 1 damage.
strings.base-encounter-kessel-maelstrom-07.secti: The Pykes demand that you prove that you are loyal to them, and them alone.
You may lose any amount of Hutt, Rebel, and Imperial reputation. Then, if you have {REP_NEG} Hutt, {REP_NEG} Rebel, and {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation, gain 1 fame and 1 Syndicate reputation.
You fly too close to an asteroid and rip your hull open. You’re losing air fast.
Test Tech. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and discard 1 of your crew. If you did not have a crew, your character suffers 3 damage.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-04.se: A Mon Calamari by the name of Raddus probes you about your loyalties.
If you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame. Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}15,000 to gain 1 fame.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
A one-eyed Quarren leans close to you and whispers, “I heard you’re looking for a job.”
Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_JOB} market deck. You may buy 1 of these cards. Then shuffle the deck.
Will you help root out traitors?
Action: Choose another player who has {REP_POS} Rebel reputation or a Rebel crew. That player loses 1 Imperial reputation and you gain {CREDITS}2,000 and 1 Imperial reputation.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-03.se: A cargo hauler offers to transport you and your ship across the galaxy.
Action: Spend {CREDITS}3,000 to move directly to any space. If you have {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, you may do this for free.
You have an opportunity to make a donation to the Academy for Young Imperials. Make it large enough, and they might even name a building after you.
If you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame. Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}15,000 to gain 1 fame.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
The Academy for Young Imperials is looking for funds to bolster their flight training program.
You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain 1 Imperial reputation.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-02.se: A Mon Calamari cruiser is embarking to meet up with a Rebel cell. You could probably hitch a ride.

If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation, you may move directly to the Rebel patrol’s space. If you do not move, you may gain 1 Rebel reputation. If you gain the reputation, lose 1 Imperial reputation.
The Imperials are offering a good price for taking down Rebel agents.

Encounter: Discard this card to fight a combat against a player in your space who has either {REP_POS} Rebel reputation or {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation. If you win, gain 1 fame and 1 Imperial reputation.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-01.se: The engineer offers to modify your hyperdrive with some military grade tech.
You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the mod below.
Governor Pryce asks for help chasing down a Rebel ship.
When you win a combat against a Rebel patrol, you may discard this card to gain 1 fame and 1 Imperial reputation.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-01-as: You may discard this card during your planning step to gain +4 {HYPERDRIVE} until the end of the turn.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-00.se: “We’ve tracked a ship carrying Wookiee slaves to Kessel,” the Rebel operative tells you. “Are you up for a rescue mission?”
You may gain the job below.
“The Empire looks after its citizens,” the Imperial officer says as he assesses the damage.
Recover all damage from your character and ship. If your character and ship did not have any damage, you instead gain {CREDITS}2,000.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-00-as: Gain {CREDITS}5,000, 1 fame, and 1 Rebel reputation. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-09.se: Refugees on many Imperial worlds are seeking a better life elsewhere.
Action: If you are on an Imperial planet, you may gain the cargo above.
Dozens of refugees are seeking to flee the brutal conditions imposed by the Imperial occupation.
You may gain the cargo below.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-09-as: When you discard this card, lose 1 Rebel reputation unless you delivered it.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-08.se: A racing enthusiast wants you to take out his favorite fathier’s top competition.
You may gain the job below.
A local politician asks you to bring a message to the Rebellion. You instead consider turning them in to the authorities.
You may lose 1 Rebel reputation to gain {CREDITS}4,000.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-08-as: Gain {CREDITS}10,000 and 1 fame. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-07.se: The Rebellion is looking for new recruits.
Action: Choose another player in your space who has {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation. That player may gain {CREDITS}10,000 and 1 Rebel reputation. If they do, you gain 1 fame and discard this card.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
You have a chance to free a Whaladon from captivity.
You may gain 1 Rebel reputation. If you do, lose 1 Imperial reputation.
“What do you know of the Rebel Alliance?” the officer asks you, while his stormtroopers stand at the ready.
Choose a player. That player gains 1 Rebel reputation and their character suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-06.se: Someone calling themselves Fulcrum is looking for loyal Rebel agents.
You may take the “Rebel Favor” job card from another player or the {DECK_JOB} market deck. If you take it from the {DECK_JOB} deck, shuffle that deck.
Imperial customs agents are willing to make exceptions for friends of the Empire.

You may deliver 1 of your cargo for its reward regardless of its destination. If it is ILLEGAL, you can deliver it without rolling a die.
If you do not deliver cargo, you buy the top card of the {DECK_CARGO} market deck for free.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
The ISB agent asks you to prove your loyalty.
You may lose 1 Rebel reputation to gain 1 Imperial reputation.
strings.base-encounter-lothal-mon-calamari-05.se: A friend of the Rebellion has mapped a shortcut to Kessel.
When you move into the Maelstrom while you have {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, you may discard this card. If you do, you do not have to end your movement in that space.
An Inquisitor is looking for information on the whereabouts of Rebel insurgents.
Move the Imperial patrol up to 4 spaces in any direction.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
A military parade is being held in Tarkintown.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-00.sections.0.va: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Hutt reputation:
One of your Hutt contacts gave you coordinates to a black market space station in this area.
Choose a market deck and reveal the top 3 cards of it. You may buy 1 of these cards. Then shuffle the deck.
Move the Hutt patrol to your space and encounter it.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-00.sections.1.va: You share information with the Hutts about the location of a wanted fugitive.
Action: Discard this card to move the Hutt patrol directly to the space of your choice.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-09.sections.0.va: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
The smuggler grins at you. “You think you’re the better pilot? Why don’t you prove it in that asteroid field?”
You may test Piloting. If you pass, gain {CREDITS}3,000. If you fail, your ship suffers 3 damage.
There appears to be a bounty hunter on your tail.
Test Piloting. If you fail, fight a ship combat against a bounty hunter ({SHIP_COMBAT} 4). If you win, prevent 2 damage from this combat.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-09.sections.1.va: “We’ve heard rumors of pirate activity in this system. Do you have any leads?”
You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to move a patrol in your space directly to any space.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-08.sections.0.va: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
Imperial data about this part of space suggest there should be a shortcut up ahead.
The Empire is everywhere, and they are hunting you.
Move the Imperial patrol directly to any space that is adjacent to your space.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-08.sections.1.va: The last thing you need is unwanted attention.
You may test Stealth. If you pass, you may take an additional turn. If you fail, lose 1 reputation with a patrol in your space.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-07.sections.0.va: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
You experience engine trouble and send out a distress signal.
Move the Rebel patrol directly to your space. Then recover all damage from your ship.
You don’t notice the space mines until you’re almost on top of them. Evasive maneuvers!
Test Piloting. If you fail, your ship suffers 3 damage.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-07.sections.1.va: “To anyone that can hear us, we’ve suffered engine failure and need assistance.”
Test Tech. If you pass, gain 1 reputation with a patrol in your space; if you already had {REP_POS} reputation with this faction, you may spend {CREDITS}10,000 to gain 1 fame.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-06.sections.0.va: You find a derelict Hutt transport. The crew is missing, but they had a big haul of resources.
You may gain the cargo below. If you do, lose 1 Hutt reputation.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-06.sections.1.va: The patrol is on the lookout for a fugitive.
You may choose a player who has {REP_NEG} reputation with a patrol in your space. Move that patrol directly to that player’s space, and they must encounter that patrol.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-06-asset.name: Stolen Cargo
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-06-asset.text.0: To deliver, roll a die. On a {HIT}, deliver this. Otherwise, resolve card #1.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-04.sections.0.va: In deep space, you intercept a transmission intended for someone else.
Action: Discard this card and choose another player in your space. That player decides either to have no effect or to have each of you gain 1 fame.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-04.sections.1.va: You dock with the ship and offer information as a show of good faith.

Test Knowledge. If you pass, gain 1 reputation with a patrol in your space; if you already had {REP_POS} reputation with that faction, reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_GEAR} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed mod for free. Then shuffle the deck.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-03.sections.0.va: A mining operation recognizes your loyalty to Crimson Dawn and offers you some Clouzon-36 fuel.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
You receive a distress call from a ship trapped inside of a giant space slug.
You may test Tech. If you pass, gain {CREDITS}2,000 and 1 Syndicate reputation. If you fail, your ship suffers 3 damage.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-03.sections.1.va: The patrol asks that you cut your engines, and you consider ignoring their request.
You may test Piloting. If you pass, you may take an additional turn. If you fail, encounter a patrol in your space.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-01.sections.0.va: You catch a distress signal from a civilian ship.

Test Tech. If you pass, and you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame. If you pass and you are the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}15,000 to gain 1 fame.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
You experience engine trouble and send out a distress signal. Nobody responds.
Test Tech. If you fail, your ship suffers 2 damage.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-01.sections.1.va: They’re recruiting informants in this sector of space.
Test Influence. If you pass, gain 1 reputation with a patrol in your space; if you already had {REP_POS} reputation with that faction, gain {CREDITS}4,000.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-05.sections.0.va: The Empire offers you the funds needed to work against the Rebellion.
You may lose up to 2 Rebel reputation. Then, if you have {REP_NEG} Rebel reputation, gain {CREDITS}5,000.
If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
Here, in the middle of nowhere, you find a makeshift Imperial checkpoint. Better get your bribes ready.
Test Piloting. If you fail, lose {CREDITS}2,000 unless you discard 1 of your cargo.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-05.sections.1.va: You make a deal with the ship’s captain.
Action: Discard this card to move any patrol directly to your space. Then, choose a player in your space that has {REP_NEG} reputation with that patrol to encounter it.
strings.base-encounter-navpoint-02.sections.0.va: Floating through space, you devise a plan to claim someone else’s deeds as your own.

strings.base-market-job-05.name: Hutt Favor

strings.base-market-job-05.encounter: Test Influence. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, resolve card #41.
strings.base-market-job-05.reward: Gain {CREDITS}5,000 and 1 Hutt reputation. If you already had {REP_POS} Hutt reputation, you also lose 1 Syndicate reputation and gain 1 fame. Then discard this card.
strings.base-market-job-06.name: Hired Help
strings.base-market-job-06.text.0: Before you perform a skill test, you may gain a skill of your choice for that test. If you pass the test, discard this crew.
strings.base-market-job-07.name: Relic of the Past
strings.base-market-job-07.flavor: You have uncovered information about an underwater temple on Mon Calamari. Surely there is something of worth there.
strings.base-market-job-07.reward: Gain {CREDITS}5,000 and 1 fame. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-market-job-08.name: Rebel Favor
strings.base-market-job-08.flavor: The Rebel alliance is looking for someone who knows their way around Imperial installations.
strings.base-market-job-08.encounter: Test Knowledge. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, resolve card #41.
strings.base-market-job-08.reward: Gain {CREDITS}5,000 and 1 Rebel reputation. If you already had {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, you also lose 1 Imperial reputation and gain 1 fame. Then discard this card.
strings.base-market-job-09.name: Hired Help
strings.base-market-job-09.text.0: Before you perform a skill test, you may gain a skill of your choice for that test. If you pass the test, discard this crew.
strings.base-market-job-10.name: Imperial Favor
strings.base-market-job-10.flavor: The Empire wants you to prevent an arms dealer from meeting Rebel operatives on Ryloth.
strings.base-market-job-10.encounter: Test Tactics. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, resolve card #41.
strings.base-market-job-10.reward: Gain {CREDITS}5,000 and 1 Imperial reputation. If you already had {REP_POS} Imperial reputation, you also lose 1 Rebel reputation and gain 1 fame. Then discard this card.
strings.base-market-job-11.name: Syndicate Favor
strings.base-market-job-11.flavor: A crime syndicate is looking for someone who understands many languages to infiltrate the Hutt Grand Council.
strings.base-market-job-11.encounter: Test Knowledge. If you pass, complete this job. If you fail, resolve card #41.
strings.base-market-job-11.reward: Gain {CREDITS}5,000 and 1 Syndicate reputation. If you already had {REP_POS} Syndicate reputation, you also lose 1 Hutt reputation and gain 1 fame. Then discard this card.
strings.base-market-job-12.name: Hijacking a Freighter
strings.base-market-job-12.flavor: The Hutt grumbles at you, and his protocol droid translates, “My master is looking for a team to hijack a freighter.”
strings.base-market-job-12.text.0: Cannot buy on the Ring of Kafrene.
strings.base-market-job-12.reward: Gain {CREDITS}5,000, 2 fame, and 1 Hutt reputation. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-market-job-13.name: Jabba's Hidden Stash
strings.base-market-job-13.flavor: "Jabba's got so many credits, he won't even notice a few missing," the Twi'lek says. "The plan's foolproof. You in?"
strings.base-market-job-13.reward: Lose 1 Hutt reputation and gain {CREDITS}10,000 and 1 fame. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-market-luxury-00.name: Extravagant Wardrobe
strings.base-market-luxury-00.text.0: While you have 2 or 3 {REP_POS} reputations, you have 1 additional fame.
strings.base-market-luxury-00.text.1: While you have 4 {REP_POS} reputations, you have 2 additional fame.
strings.base-market-luxury-01.name: Chromium Hull
strings.base-market-luxury-01.text.0: When you gain fame, gain 1 additional fame. When you lose a ship combat, discard this card.
strings.base-market-luxury-01.text.1: A player in your space can fight a ship combat against you as their encounter.
strings.base-market-luxury-02.name: Gift for Jabba
strings.base-market-luxury-02.text.1: When you become defeated, discard 1 of your crew.
strings.base-market-luxury-03.name: Stolen Jewels
strings.base-market-luxury-03.abilities.0: Action: Choose another player in your space and discard this card. You both gain {CREDITS}7,000 and 1 fame.
strings.base-market-luxury-04.name: Sy Snootles
strings.base-market-luxury-04.text.0: When you complete a job, you may reduce the job's credit reward to {CREDITS}0 to gain 1 additional fame.
strings.base-market-luxury-05.name: Proton Torpedoes
strings.base-market-luxury-05.text.1: When you win a combat against a patrol that has a fame reward, gain 1 additional fame.
strings.base-market-luxury-06.name: Attend Statue Dedication
strings.base-market-luxury-06.flavor: Your biggest fans would like to erect a statue in your honor on their world. They have asked you to help fund the statue and to attend its dedication.
strings.base-market-luxury-06.destination: Any planet where you have {REP_POS} reputation with the planet's faction.
strings.base-market-luxury-06.reward: Gain 1 fame. You may spend {CREDITS}10,000 to gain 1 additional fame. Then remove this card from the game.
strings.base-market-luxury-07.name: Legendary Game of Sabacc
strings.base-market-luxury-07.flavor: Your skill at sabacc is well known throughout the galaxy, but another win could make you legendary. Especially if the odds are stacked against you.
strings.base-market-luxury-07.encounter: Choose another player in your space, and you resolve card #40.
strings.base-market-luxury-07.reward: Gain {CREDITS}10,000. If the active player claims this reward, they also gain 1 fame and discard this card.
strings.base-market-luxury-08.name: Undercover Agent
strings.base-market-luxury-08.abilities.0: Action: If a player in your space has more fame than you, discard this card to gain 1 fame and make that player lose 1 reputation of your choice.
strings.base-market-luxury-09.name: Mandalorian Armor
strings.base-market-luxury-09.text.1: When you gain the reward from a bounty, you may reduce the bounty's credit reward to {CREDITS}0 to gain 1 additional fame.
strings.base-market-luxury-10.name: Dejarik Holotable
strings.base-market-luxury-10.text.0: While you have 2 or more crew, you have 1 additional fame.
strings.base-market-luxury-10.abilities.0: Action: If you are at a navpoint, roll 1 die for each crew you have. For each {HIT} or {FOCUS} result, gain {CREDITS}1,000.

strings.base-market-ship-04.text.0: Buy any ship sheet from the supply that costs more than your current ship. Place the sheet on its "Ship Goal" side as normal, and the ship suffers 3 damage.
strings.base-market-ship-04.text.1: If the ship's card has not been removed from the game, search the {DECK_SHIP} market deck for the ship's card and remove it from the game. Then shuffle this card back into this deck.

strings.base-ship-aggressor-class-assault-fighte: Ship Goal: Win 2 combats against patrols to gain 1 fame and flip this sheet.
When you win a combat against a patrol, do not lose reputation with that patrol’s faction.
strings.base-ship-firespray-31-patrol-craft.name: Firespray-31 Patrol Craft
strings.base-ship-firespray-31-patrol-craft.side: Ship Goal – Encounter: Fight a ship combat against a player in your space (even if on a planet) who has more fame than you. If you win, gain 1 fame and flip this sheet.
When you move into a patrol’s space, you may test Stealth. If you pass, you do not have to end your movement in that space.

strings.base-ship-g9-rigger.sides.0.name: G9 Rigger
strings.base-ship-g9-rigger.sides.1.name: G-1A Starfighter

strings.base-ship-gx1-short-hauler.sides.0.name: GX1 Short Hauler
Ship Goal: Gain a crew while you have 2 crew to gain 1 fame and flip this sheet (keep all 3 crew).
strings.base-ship-gx1-short-hauler.sides.1.name: Valorous
During your encounter step, you are not forced to encounter patrols that you have {REP_NEG} reputation with.
strings.base-ship-heavy-duty-lifter.name: Heavy-Duty Lifter
strings.base-ship-heavy-duty-lifter.sides.0.name: Heavy-Duty Lifter
strings.base-ship-heavy-duty-lifter.sides.0.text: Ship Goal: If you have at least 1 cargo, complete a job to gain 1 fame and flip this sheet.
strings.base-ship-heavy-duty-lifter.sides.1.name: Ark Angel
strings.base-ship-heavy-duty-lifter.sides.1.text: Gain +1 {HYPERDRIVE} for each job you have.

strings.base-ship-hwk-290-freighter.sides.0.name: HWK-290 Freighter
strings.base-ship-hwk-290-freighter.sides.0.text: Ship Goal – Action: If you have a mod, spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame and flip this sheet.
strings.base-ship-hwk-290-freighter.sides.1.name: Moldy Crow
strings.base-ship-lancer-class-pursuit-craft.sid: Ship Goal: Deliver a contact on 1 of your bounty cards to gain 1 fame and flip this sheet.
When another player moves into your space, you may force them to end their movement.
strings.base-ship-modified-yt-1300-light-freight: Ship Goal: If you have either 2 mods or 1 mod and the “Chewbacca” crew, deliver 1 cargo to gain 1 fame and flip this sheet.
When you are rolling a die to deliver ILLEGAL cargo, you may turn a {FOCUS} or {CRIT} result to a {HIT}.
strings.base-ship-yv-666-light-freighter.name: YV-666 Light Freighter
strings.base-ship-yv-666-light-freighter.sides.0: Ship Goal: When you recover at least 1 damage from this ship, spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame and flip this sheet.
strings.base-ship-yv-666-light-freighter.sides.1: When you would become defeated during a ship combat, roll a die. On a {FOCUS} or {HIT} result, recover 2 damage from your ship instead.
